src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2011 congressional plan (Georgia Congressional Reapportionment Act of 2011, 2011 special session)
Office of the Governor, Deal signs congressional map (Sept. 7, 2011)

Fourteen districts, signed by Gov. Deal in September 2011 (the Governor's release is dated Sept. 7); used 2012 through 2020. Census file basis: the Bureau's user note says its 116th Congress and 2018-election-year legislative districts carry no later changes.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 Senate plan (S.B. 1EX, signed Aug. 24, 2011) as adjusted by S.B. 430 (2012), the 'previous 2014 Senate plan'
Office of the Governor, Deal signs House and Senate maps (Aug. 24, 2011)

The 2012 adjustment (S.B. 430) was first used in 2014 and stayed in force through 2020. Census file basis: the Bureau's user note says its 116th Congress and 2018-election-year legislative districts carry no later changes.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 House plan (H.B. 1EX, signed Aug. 24, 2011) as adjusted in 2012 and by H.B. 566 (Act 251, 2015), the 'previous 2015 House plan'
Office of the Governor, Deal signs House and Senate maps (Aug. 24, 2011)

Used through 2020. The 2015 act's exact signing date was not found, so used_from is its year only. Census file basis: the Bureau's user note says its 116th Congress and 2018-election-year legislative districts carry no later changes.
